id.label: Site SEO ID
id.help: A unique ID for this record. For a Single Object Collection this is the collection id.

siteName.label: Site Name
siteName.help: Used in titles, og:site_name and the WebSite / Organization JSON-LD. Falls back to the General settings site name.

baseUrl.label: Base URL
baseUrl.help: Absolute origin for canonical URLs and JSON-LD ids, e.g. https://example.com. Defaults to this site's domain.

socialTitleTemplate.label: Social Title Template
socialTitleTemplate.help: Shapes og:title and twitter:title, independent of the Title Template. ${title} and ${site} are replaced. Default: ${title}

defaultDescription.label: Default Description
defaultDescription.help: Used when a page or object has no description of its own.

defaultImage.label: Default Social Image
defaultImage.help: Social sharing image used when nothing more specific resolves (1200×630 recommended)

organizationLogo.label: Organization Logo
organizationLogo.help: Square logo for the Organization structured data, at least 112×112

icon.label: Favicon
icon.help: Square PNG, 512×512 or larger. Browser tabs, bookmarks and Google results, and served as /favicon.ico. Without it they show a generic globe.

touchIcon.label: Touch Icon
touchIcon.help: Square PNG, 180×180 or larger, with a solid background — iOS paints transparent pixels black. Leave empty to use the Icon.

iconSvg.label: Favicon (SVG)
iconSvg.help: Optional vector icon, served as /favicon.svg and listed before the PNG so browsers that can use it do.

themeColor.label: Theme Color
themeColor.help: Hex colour for the browser chrome around the page on phones (meta theme-color). Leave empty to emit none.

sameAs.label: Social Profiles
sameAs.help: One absolute URL per line (X, Instagram, LinkedIn, GitHub…). Emitted as Organization.sameAs.

contactEmail.label: Contact Email
contactEmail.help: A public address for the organization. Emitted as Organization.email and a customer-support ContactPoint in the JSON-LD.

contactUrl.label: Contact URL
contactUrl.help: The page people should use to reach you — a support or contact page. Emitted on the ContactPoint.

metaTags.label: Meta Tags
metaTags.help: Printed in the <head> exactly as written, after the SEO tags, on every page that calls cms.seo.head() or cms.seo.meta(). Paste the verification tag Google, Bing or Pinterest give you, or any other meta, link or script tag the site needs.

emitSocial.label: Emit Open Graph and Twitter tags

created.label: Date Created
created.help: The date this record was created

updated.label: Date Updated
updated.help: The date this record was last updated
